machine.description: an actual computer with a stable identity and an optional connector address; without a reachable address it is inventory, not an execution target

provider.description: Retained until the coordinated workspace migration: the configured provider that lends or attaches this machine

from.description: Retained until the coordinated workspace migration: the commit in the graph this machine starts from; absent for an empty machine

image.description: Retained until the coordinated workspace migration: the image a sandbox boots, when its provider boots images

state.description: Retained until the coordinated workspace migration: the provider's last recorded lifecycle state

address.description: the connection address selecting a configured computer connector; changing it preserves computer identity

workspace.description: a file-and-command target on a computer or in a sandbox; its root is a default directory, not an access boundary. Missing placement is unknown, never this host

machine.description: the computer whose filesystem or sandbox contains this target; absent only when a backend cannot disclose placement

root.description: the default absolute directory in this filesystem; placement and root remain fixed for the resource lifetime

sandbox.description: the enclosing sandbox whose filesystem interprets paths; on a sandbox workspace the sandbox is the entity itself, not a self reference
